chunks: And from him, from Muhammad, from Saif, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The throwing of the Jamarat is between the sunrise and the sunset.'
ai.seo_question: What is the valid time range for throwing the Jamarat during Hajj according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* delineates the specific temporal window for Rami al-Jamarat, affirming that the ritual may be performed from sunrise until sunset. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the permissibility of performing the rite throughout the day of Arafat and the Days of Tashriq, distinguishing it from the stricter time limits of other Hajj obligations. It underscores the flexibility granted to pilgrims while maintaining the sanctity of the ritual timing.
